29:64.text: And this life of the world is only an amusement and a play! Verily, the home of the Hereafter - that is the life indeed
(i.e. the eternal life that will never end)

29:65.text: And when they embark on a ship, they invoke Allâh, making their Faith pure for Him only: but when He brings them safely to land, behold, they give a share of their worship to others

29:66.text: So that they become ingrate for that which We have given them, and that they take their enjoyment
, but they will come to know.

29:67.text: Have they not seen that We have made
a secure sanctuary, while men are being snatched away from all around them? Then do they believe in Bâtil
(falsehood - polytheism, idols and all deities other than Allâh)

29:68.text: And who does more wrong than he who invents a lie against Allâh or denies the truth
(Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his doctrine of Islâmic Monotheism and this Qur’ân)
, when it comes to him? Is there not a dwelling in Hell for disbelievers
(in the Oneness of Allâh and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

29:69.text: As for those who strive hard in Us
, We will surely guide them to Our Paths
. And verily, Allâh is with the Muhsinûn

30:3.text: , and they, after their defeat, will be victorious.

30:4.text: Within three to nine years. The decision of the matter, before and after
(before the defeat of the Romans by the Persians, and after the defeat of the Persians by the Romans)
. And on that Day, the believers
(at the victory given by Allâh to the Romans against the Persians)

30:5.text: With the help of Allâh. He helps whom He wills, and He is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
